summary: Implemented App.call_from_thread in src/textual/app.py with thread-entry state (_loop, _thread_id) set and cleared in run()'s run_app coroutine. Added tests/test_concurrency.py with 10 tests; all pass when run with PYTHONPATH=src using the generator venv Python. Nothing committed. Caveat: the venv imports an installed textual instead of the repo src, so PYTHONPATH=src is required. Existing async tests (test_call_later, test_widget, test_screens, etc.) fail in this environment with "async def functions are not natively supported" because pytest-asyncio isn't loaded; I did not verify them against the original code.
